families.name: Cut
families.definition: A changes to B between two consecutive frames, with no in-between frames.

subfamilies.name: Match Cut
subfamilies.definition: A and B share a form, motion, colour or composition, so the eye carries across.

subfamilies.name: Smash Cut
subfamilies.definition: An abrupt jump in tone, volume or energy, for contrast or comedy.

subfamilies.name: Jump Cut
subfamilies.definition: The same subject with a jump in time.

subfamilies.name: Audio-Led
subfamilies.definition: Sound leads or trails the picture (J/L cuts), or a sound hit drives the cut.

families.name: Blend
families.definition: A and B mix by opacity. Nothing moves and no edge travels across the frame.

subfamilies.name: Crossfade
subfamilies.definition: A fades out while B fades in.

subfamilies.name: Dip to Colour
subfamilies.definition: A fades to a flat colour, then B fades in from it.

subfamilies.name: Luma Dissolve
subfamilies.definition: The image's own brightness decides which pixels change first.

subfamilies.name: Blend Mode
subfamilies.definition: The mix uses a blend mode instead of normal opacity.

families.name: Wipe
families.definition: A moving, designed boundary separates A from B until B fills the frame.

subfamilies.name: Linear
subfamilies.definition: A straight edge sweeps across.

subfamilies.name: Iris
subfamilies.definition: A circle or shape grows from, or shrinks to, a point.

subfamilies.name: Clock
subfamilies.definition: An edge rotates around a centre.

subfamilies.name: Shape Mask
subfamilies.definition: B appears through a growing designed shape.

subfamilies.name: Pattern
subfamilies.definition: Many small edges at once, in a grid or repeat.

subfamilies.name: Organic
subfamilies.definition: An irregular, noise-driven edge, with no full cover.

families.name: Cover
families.definition: A third layer (neither A nor B) covers the frame, hides the change, then uncovers B.

subfamilies.name: Organic
subfamilies.definition: The cover is a fluid, natural or noise-driven substance.

subfamilies.name: Geometric
subfamilies.definition: The cover is built from clean shapes.

subfamilies.name: Stroke
subfamilies.definition: Drawn strokes sweep across and fill the frame.

subfamilies.name: Panel
subfamilies.definition: Solid slabs slide or unfold across, then off.

subfamilies.name: Stinger
subfamilies.definition: A branded or character graphic covers the cut.

families.name: Motion
families.definition: The picture moves rigidly: A and B translate, rotate, scale or flip, whole or in rigid slices.

subfamilies.name: Push Slide
subfamilies.definition: B pushes A out, or slides over it.

subfamilies.name: Whip
subfamilies.definition: A very fast move with motion blur hiding the seam.

subfamilies.name: Zoom
subfamilies.definition: Scale through the frame.

subfamilies.name: Spin
subfamilies.definition: Rotation in the picture plane.

subfamilies.name: 3D Space
subfamilies.definition: Rigid 3D moves of the frame.

subfamilies.name: Split
subfamilies.definition: The frame divides into rigid slices that move apart or together.

families.name: Distortion
families.definition: The image deforms, degrades or breaks apart, and B emerges from the damage.

subfamilies.name: Glitch
subfamilies.definition: Digital corruption.

subfamilies.name: Warp
subfamilies.definition: Smooth non-rigid deformation.

subfamilies.name: Blur
subfamilies.definition: Focus or directional blur peaks at the cut.

subfamilies.name: Pixel
subfamilies.definition: The image breaks into pixels or sorted pixels.

subfamilies.name: Break
subfamilies.definition: The image fractures into pieces or particles.

families.name: Morph
families.definition: An element in A changes, through in-between frames, into a different element in B.

subfamilies.name: Shape
subfamilies.definition: One vector shape interpolates into another.

subfamilies.name: Type
subfamilies.definition: Letters or words change into other letters, words or shapes.

subfamilies.name: Object
subfamilies.definition: A depicted object becomes another object.

subfamilies.name: Image Morph
subfamilies.definition: Whole images warp into each other via corresponding points.

families.name: Carry
families.definition: A specific element keeps its identity and leads the viewer from A into B.

subfamilies.name: Object-Led
subfamilies.definition: An object travels across and becomes part of B's layout.

subfamilies.name: Line-Led
subfamilies.definition: A drawn line or path becomes B's structure.

subfamilies.name: Type-Led
subfamilies.definition: A word or title stays while the scene rebuilds around it.

subfamilies.name: Portal
subfamilies.definition: The camera moves into an element that contains B.

families.name: Light
families.definition: Light washes over the cut: the in-between is luminance, glow or optical artefact.

subfamilies.name: Flash
subfamilies.definition: A short burst of bright exposure with bloom.

subfamilies.name: Leak
subfamilies.definition: Soft coloured light drifts across.

subfamilies.name: Burn
subfamilies.definition: Film or paper burns through.

subfamilies.name: Flare
subfamilies.definition: A lens flare or light streak sweeps across.

transitions.name: Anchored Match Cut
transitions.summary: A hard cut that lines up a point in the next scene with a point in the old one, then eases the new scene back to its own framing.
uses: Match cuts on shape or position

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale of scene B at the cut.

transitions.name: Smash Cut with Shake
transitions.summary: A hard cut to the next scene, which lands with a short, decaying camera shake.

params.name: cutAt
params.description: Where in the transition the cut happens (0..1).

transitions.name: Strobe Cut
transitions.summary: Cuts back and forth between the two scenes faster and faster, then lands on the new one.

params.name: flips
params.description: How many times the picture swaps.

transitions.name: Punch-in Jump Cut
transitions.summary: Cuts to the next shot framed tighter, then cuts again to the normal framing: the vlog punch-in for emphasis.

transitions.name: Crossfade
transitions.summary: Scene A fades out while scene B fades in. The classic dissolve.

transitions.name: Dip to Colour
transitions.summary: Fades to a flat colour, holds, then fades up on the next scene.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Luma Dissolve
transitions.summary: Scene A dissolves by its own brightness: its highlights vanish first and its shadows last, showing scene B behind.

params.name: softness
params.description: Width of the dissolve band in brightness.

transitions.name: Film Dissolve
transitions.summary: An additive dissolve: both scenes add together, so the midpoint glows like a film dissolve.

transitions.name: Linear Wipe
transitions.summary: A straight edge sweeps across the frame at any angle, hard or soft. Split mode opens from the middle like barn doors.

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction the edge travels, in degrees (90 = left to right).

params.name: softness
params.description: Edge softness, as a percentage of the frame.

params.name: mode
params.description: single: one edge. split: two edges open from the centre.

transitions.name: Iris
transitions.summary: A circle opens from a point and grows until the new scene fills the frame.

transitions.name: Rounded Reveal
transitions.summary: The new scene opens in a rounded window that grows from the centre to full frame, settling from a slight zoom inside.

params.name: corner
params.description: Corner radius as a share of frame height (it eases to square at the end).

transitions.name: Text Mask Zoom
transitions.summary: A word appears with the new scene inside its letters, then zooms through one letter until the new scene fills the frame.

params.name: text
params.description: The word that reveals the new scene.

params.name: focus
params.description: Point of the word the zoom heads into, across its width (0..1).

params.name: background
params.description: Colour around the word before it fills the frame.

transitions.name: Halftone Wipe
transitions.summary: A wave of dots grows across the frame, from tiny to touching, with the new scene inside them.

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction the wave travels, in degrees.

transitions.name: Stripe Wipe
transitions.summary: Diagonal stripes of the new scene open one after another and widen until they join.

params.name: stagger
params.description: How much the stripes open one after another.

transitions.name: Noise Wipe
transitions.summary: A ragged, noise-driven edge sweeps across the frame, like a torn or eroded border.
uses: Softer alternative to a linear wipe

params.name: roughness
params.description: How far the edge wanders, as a fraction of the frame.

transitions.name: Ink Bleed
transitions.summary: Drops of ink land and spread with fibrous edges until the frame is solid, then the next scene bleeds back through.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Liquid Fill
transitions.summary: Blobs of liquid grow into cells with thin veins, the veins pinch away until the frame is one colour, then the next scene floods back in the same way.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: seed
params.description: Blob layout. The reveal uses seed + 1.

params.name: rows
params.description: Blobs across the frame height; more means smaller cells.

params.name: gap
params.description: Half the vein width, as a fraction of frame height.

params.name: wobble
params.description: How much the liquid edge wobbles.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Paint Drip
transitions.summary: Paint pours down from the top in uneven drips that join into a solid frame, then drains away to show the next scene.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Shape Burst
transitions.summary: Rings of colour burst out from a point one after another until the last one covers the frame, then a hole bursts open the same way.

params.name: colors
params.description: Ring colours in order; the last one covers the frame, so make it the incoming scene's background colour.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Shape Grid
transitions.summary: A grid of shapes scales up in a wave until they cover the frame, then shrinks away in the same direction to show the next scene.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Brush Stroke
transitions.summary: A thick, rough brush paints across the frame in a few passes until it is covered, then the stroke wipes away to show the next scene.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: passes
params.description: How many back-and-forth strokes cover the frame.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Swoosh Lines
transitions.summary: Waves of rounded diagonal ribbons sweep across, the last wave in the new background colour, then sweep on out to show the new scene.

params.name: colors
params.description: One colour per wave; the last wave covers the frame (use the incoming background colour).

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Panel Slide
transitions.summary: Solid bars slide in one after another to cover the frame, then carry on out the other side to show the next scene.

params.name: colors
params.description: Panel colours in order; the last one ends on top, so make it the incoming scene's background colour.

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between bars, as a share of each phase.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered.

transitions.name: Logo Stinger
transitions.summary: A badge pops in, spins and grows to fill the frame with a word on it, then shrinks back and pops away to show the next scene.

params.name: color
params.description: Badge colour; use the incoming scene's background colour.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition spent fully covered (the word is readable here).

transitions.name: Push
transitions.summary: The new scene pushes the old one out of frame.

params.name: curve
params.description: Ease curve; expo is the snappiest.

transitions.name: Slide Over
transitions.summary: The new scene slides in over the old one like a card, with a soft shadow, while the old one drifts back and dims.

params.name: dim
params.description: How dark the old scene gets.

params.name: drift
params.description: How far the old scene moves along, as a share of the new one's travel.

transitions.name: Whip Pan
transitions.summary: A very fast pan with heavy motion blur that hides the cut, as if the camera whipped to the next scene.

transitions.name: Grid Zoom
transitions.summary: The camera pulls back until the old scene is one tile in a grid of tiles in the new colour, glides to the next tile and dives into it, which becomes the new scene.

params.name: color
params.description: Colour of the other tiles; use the incoming scene's background colour.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Tile size when pulled back, as a share of the frame.

transitions.name: Zoom Through
transitions.summary: A circle in the new background colour opens on the old scene and the camera rushes into it; it fills the frame and the new scene lands.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: amount
params.description: How far the old scene zooms in.

transitions.name: Spin
transitions.summary: A shape in the new background colour spins in at the centre and grows while the camera rolls with it, until it fills the frame; the new scene then spins into place.

params.name: color
params.description: The incoming scene's background colour; the transition brings it in.

params.name: turns
params.description: Turns the shape makes while it grows.

params.name: roll
params.description: Degrees the camera rolls along with it.

transitions.name: Shutter
transitions.summary: The old scene splits into two halves that slide apart like doors, with the new scene behind them.

params.name: orientation
params.description: vertical: halves part left and right. horizontal: up and down.

params.name: scaleIn
params.description: How much the new scene settles from a zoom as it is revealed.

transitions.name: Slice In
transitions.summary: The new scene arrives in vertical slices that slide up into place one after another.

params.name: stagger
params.description: How much the slices arrive one after another.

transitions.name: Split Slices
transitions.summary: The old scene breaks into horizontal slices that slide off alternately left and right, showing the new scene behind.

params.name: stagger
params.description: How much the slices move one after another.

transitions.name: RGB Glitch
transitions.summary: The picture tears into shifted colour channels and displaced blocks, and the new scene glitches in.

transitions.name: Liquid Warp
transitions.summary: The picture ripples and melts like a reflection in water, and the new scene ripples back into focus.

transitions.name: Pixel Stretch
transitions.summary: The new scene sweeps in with its leading edge smeared into long streaks, like pixels stretched by speed.
uses: A sharper alternative to a whip pan

params.name: streak
params.description: Longest streak, as a share of the frame width.

transitions.name: Defocus
transitions.summary: The old scene drifts out of focus, and the new one comes into focus.

params.name: zoom
params.description: Slight zoom while out of focus.

transitions.name: Pixelate
transitions.summary: The picture breaks into growing blocks of pixels, swaps at the coarsest point, then sharpens into the new scene.

params.name: steps
params.description: Number of block sizes on the way up.

transitions.name: Paper Tear
transitions.summary: The old scene rips down the middle along a ragged edge, and the two pieces pull apart to show the new scene.

params.name: paper
params.description: Colour of the torn paper edge.

transitions.name: Frame Morph
transitions.summary: The whole frame rounds and shrinks into a circle, the picture inside becomes the new scene, and the circle grows back into the full frame.
uses: Changing topic with one continuous object

params.name: background
params.description: Colour that closes in around the shrinking frame; use the incoming scene's background colour.

params.name: size
params.description: Circle size at the middle, as a share of frame height.

transitions.name: Type Morph
transitions.summary: A word melts into another word with a gooey liquid morph while the scene behind changes.

params.name: panel
params.description: Colour of the band behind the word; use the incoming scene's background colour.

transitions.name: Blob Morph
transitions.summary: The frame collapses into a wobbling liquid blob, which turns into the new scene and swells back to fill the frame.

params.name: background
params.description: Colour that closes in around the shrinking frame; use the incoming scene's background colour.

transitions.name: Dot Led
transitions.summary: A dot bounces across the old scene and lands, then the new scene grows out of it.

params.name: color
params.description: Colour of the leading element; use the incoming scene's background colour so it becomes the new background.

params.name: size
params.description: Dot size, as a share of frame height.

transitions.name: Line Led
transitions.summary: A line draws across the frame, then opens into a band that becomes the new scene as its edges travel out of frame.

params.name: color
params.description: Colour of the leading element; use the incoming scene's background colour so it becomes the new background.

transitions.name: Type Led
transitions.summary: A word lands on the old scene and stays put while the scene changes behind it, then flies away.

params.name: text
params.description: The word that carries the change.

transitions.name: Portal Zoom
transitions.summary: A round window opens in the old scene showing the new one, and the camera flies into it.
uses: Diving into a screen, window or detail

params.name: radius
params.description: Opening size of the portal, as a share of frame height.

transitions.name: Flash
transitions.summary: A burst of overexposed light blows out the old scene and settles on the new one.

params.name: bloom
params.description: How much the scenes overexpose around the flash.

transitions.name: Light Leak
transitions.summary: Soft, warm light drifts across the frame and floods it, hiding the change, then fades off the new scene.

params.name: colors
params.description: Leak colours, from edge to core.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition at full brightness.

transitions.name: Film Burn
transitions.summary: Holes burn through the old scene with glowing edges until the frame is white-hot, then it cools to reveal the new scene.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition at full burn.

transitions.name: Flare Sweep
transitions.summary: An anamorphic lens flare streaks across the frame and blooms over the cut.

params.name: hold
params.description: Share of the transition at full bloom.
